Privacy

Publisher: Subahini Nadarajh. Effective date: 25 October 2026. Version: 0.1.0.

Packaged mobile app

ArrayStep stores study notes, answer drafts, completion status and quiz results locally on your device using web storage. It does not send these records to a server operated by the publisher. There are no ads, analytics SDKs, user accounts or live AI calls in this version. Lessons are bundled with the app.

Backups and deletion

Export creates a JSON progress file and lets you choose where to save or share it. The destination you choose receives that file; it may contain personal material you wrote in your notes. Import replaces local progress after confirmation. Clear app data, remove the app or clear the relevant browser storage to delete local records. Files exported elsewhere must be deleted separately. Device or operating-system backups may also retain app data according to your device settings.

External services

Optional LeetCode links open an external browser. That service receives ordinary connection information and applies its own privacy policy. ArrayStep does not include LeetCode accounts, tracking code or problem submissions.

Private hosted trial

The web trial is hosted through ChatGPT Sites and uses its sign-in and hosting infrastructure. The hosting provider may process account and connection information under its own privacy policy. Local study records are not synchronized through that sign-in.

Contact

The store release must include the publisher’s verified support contact and public policy URL. Those store details are pending; this is the trial policy and packaged-app policy draft.
